query:
-- 刪除重複記錄，保留每組 (workerId, jobCategoryId) 中 id 最小的那筆
DELETE FROM workerJobCategories
WHERE id NOT IN (
  SELECT min_id FROM (
    SELECT MIN(id) AS min_id
    FROM workerJobCategories
    GROUP BY workerId, jobCategoryId
  ) AS keep
);

-- 確認結果
SELECT workerId, jobCategoryId, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM workerJobCategories
GROUP BY workerId, jobCategoryId
HAVING cnt > 1;
